title: The project brief (stored form; the sections are patched by notes-entretien, whose schema repeats these sub-schemas)

source.description: Where the brief comes from: a pitch, a full text, or an existing project reconstructed.

arc.description: (French) Two to four sentences: what the story tells and its tipping point.

genreTon.description: (French) Genre and tone, in one or two sentences.

nom.description: (French) The style named explicitly (animation 2D, live-action cinématographique…).

clause.description: (English) One or two sentences, added as is at the start of every video description (and of image prompts when the project has no long image prompt). It describes the RENDERING (medium, line, colours, light), never a framing, a movement or an action (« dynamic shots », « cinematic action » have no place on a character sheet).

promptImage.description: (English) Set by the application when the project is created, never by you: leave it out.

image.description: Set by the application (file name of the style picture): leave it out.

dureeEpisodeSecondes.description: Target duration of an episode, in seconds. The one the user said or validated: do not invent it silently (see `questionsOuvertes`).

rythme.description: General cadence of the episode: lent (contemplative, long plans), mesure, soutenu, rapide (lively montage, dense cuts) or variable (alternates by scene). It sets plan duration and cut density downstream.

univers.description: (French) If the project takes up a pre-existing work or universe: which, and how to respect it (names, appearances, rules). Absent for an original project.

episodes.description: One episode per entry. For a full text: the proposed and validated split.

resume.description: (French) What the episode tells, in a few sentences.

portee.description: (French) For a full text: the chapters or arc covered.

age.description: (French) Concrete apparent age: « adolescente, 15 ans », « homme d'une quarantaine d'années ». It drives the image AND the voice: never left to chance.

apparence.description: (French) What is SEEN: silhouette, face, hair, outfit, distinguishing marks. Visual only: no role, no voice, no action.

reconnaissable.description: (French) What makes them recognizable in one sentence.

gestuelle.description: (French) How the character moves or acts when that is what defines them (fighting style, trade, gait, tic). Empty if they have no marked gesture.

voix.description: (French) Expected vocal impression, if they speak: consistent with age. Empty otherwise.

tenue.description: (French) The outfit, precise enough to draw a character sheet. Never « inspirée de… » or « style de… » alone: name colours and materials. Optional: fill only what the conversation gives or what you propose.

coupe.description: (French) Cut and shape of the garments: « tunique longue fendue sur les côtés, pantalon ample serré aux chevilles ».

couleurs.description: (French) Named colours: « safran et ocre, liseré bleu nuit ». Never « les couleurs de X ».

matieres.description: (French) Materials and textures: « coton épais, ceinture de cuir patiné ».

accessoires.description: (French) What they wear or carry that is seen (bâton, sacoche, collier). Empty if none.

signeDistinctif.description: (French) The mark that sets the outfit or the body apart (emblème brodé, déchirure, tatouage visible). Empty if none.

evolution.description: (French) Whether the outfit changes during the film, and when: « identique du début à la fin », « manteau perdu après la chute ».

statut.description: Set by the application from the quotations, never by you: leave it out.
Supplied by the user, deduced by you, or uncertain (reconstruction).

aspect.description: (French) How the place looks, precise enough to draw a set. Optional: fill only what the conversation gives or what you propose.

lumiere.description: (French) Light and time of day: « fin d'après-midi, soleil rasant orangé, longues ombres ».

matieres.description: (French) Materials and textures: « pierre claire usée, boiseries rouges, tuiles vertes ».

palette.description: (French) Dominant named colours: « ocre, blanc cassé, touches de turquoise ».

ambiance.description: (French) Atmosphere in a few words (vent, poussière, silence, foule).

statut.description: Set by the application from the quotations, never by you: leave it out.

elements.description: (French) Visual effects (a power, a magic, fire, smoke) and story objects that matter on screen. Only what the story calls for; empty if none.

nom.description: (French) Short name: « Le souffle de vent de Lina », « La lanterne de cuivre ».

nature.description: vfx: a visual effect (power, magic, fire, smoke, light); prop: an object handled or seen.

description.description: (French) What it is, in one sentence.

couleur.description: (French) Named colours: « bleu pâle translucide, cœur blanc ».

ampleur.description: (French) Size or extent: « tient dans la main », « remplit la cour ».

comportement.description: (French) How it moves or behaves: « tourbillonne en spirale puis se dissipe », « s'ouvre d'un coup sec ».

statut.description: Set by the application from the quotations, never by you: leave it out.

inventions.description: (French) What the agent assumed, for information.

questionsOuvertes.description: (French) What remains uncertain. Never filled in silently.

notes.description: Free project notes: only what the user wrote as such (loose instructions, reminders), kept in the user's own words. You never invent it: leave the key absent if they gave none.

statuts.description: For each section you filled (keys: titre, arc, genreTon, style, langueDialogues, dureeEpisodeSecondes, rythme, univers, episodes, personnages, lieux, elements, notes), who set it: fourni (the user said it), deduit (concluded or assumed by the agent), a_valider (legacy value, treated as deduit by the code; `incertain` on a character or place is read the same way). Correspondence with the notes sheet (notes-entretien): origine dit = fourni, delegue = delegue (a proposal the user left to the agent), invente = deduit; `fin` (aucune/dit/delegue) is tracked outside the brief.
